guideUpdate.title: Open, cancel, and reopen Surveyor configuration in V4 GIS
guideUpdate.affectedSection: Opening and cancelling Surveyor configuration in V4 GIS
steps: In the GIS layer catalogue, select the Surveyor configuration control to open its configuration dialog.
Select Cancel to close the dialog and return to the GIS map and layer catalogue without adding a layer.
To open the configuration again, select the Surveyor configuration control once more.
Select Cancel in the reopened dialog to return to GIS with the existing map and layer state unchanged.
screenshotCaptions: Surveyor configuration is open with Cancel and Add layer controls visible; no layer has been added.
The Surveyor dialog is closed and the GIS map and layer catalogue are visible with Map layers still absent.
Surveyor configuration has reopened with Cancel and Add layer controls available.
After cancelling again, GIS is visible with the original absent Map layers state preserved.
guideUpdate.reason: Adds the missing end-user instructions for opening, cancelling, and reopening Surveyor configuration without adding a layer or changing the existing GIS state.
